label: Supply
definition: The amount of some good or service a producer is willing to produce and/or bring to market at each price; in economic terminology, the relationship between a range of prices and the quantities supplied at those prices.

scope.text: Introductory economics; markets for goods and services

notes: Source explicitly distinguishes supply (the curve/relationship) from quantity supplied (a point on the curve). Definition is embedded here as a deliberate pilot variation.
